caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a mortar with a pestle resting inside it, both oriented with the base facing downward and the pestle extending out to the upper left. The mortar is cylindrical in shape with a wide rim and a narrow waist, flaring out again at the base. The pestle has a bulbous end and a slightly tapered handle. The objects are rendered in shades of gray, giving a sense of three-dimensionality and volume through shading and highlights. The objects are centrally positioned against a plain, light tan or beige background with no additional elements or details. There is a signature or inscription in the bottom right corner of the image, written in small, neat script.
title: Mortar and Pestle Sign
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
